added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's gate_before.log (base 9f53972b2) and table_run_1.log (head 93b083114); the run is implement-role so its manifest carries no baseline_suite/after_suite fields

findings.text: follow-on: the four-arm test asserts only table[arm] > control, so the done_when's quantitative criterion (current_tool within 0.012 of 0.7920) is printed but never asserted and a future regression in current_tool's ranking reddens nothing; the criterion is judged by hand.

follow-on: the psc_cref3snu label the done_when names explicitly is in no arm's top 10 on the settled graph, so removing it leaves the table passing (negative_control_declared.log EXIT=0); that label carries no guard and its grade is assertion-free.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 9f53972b2; four commits (d60431215, 93b083114, bc6c63d78, 83c08fd4c) add 29 fixture labels and 95 lines of evidence HTML across two fragments, with no product source or test code changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks that every eligible candidate any arm places in a top 10 carries a grade, that the table test run twice scores every arm, and that current_tool's mean nDCG@10 sits no lower than 0.012 below 0.7920; the gate log table_run_1.log/table_run_2.log (rev 93b083114) prints all five arms and passes, but the 0.012 clause is not asserted by any test and its figure (0.7773 vs 0.7920 = -0.0147) is unmet, which the manifest names as a blocker the coordinator then accepted (status-repair.json).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to label the candidates the re-embed lifted into the golden arms' top 10 and score the harness on the re-embedded graph; the landed diff adds exactly 29 such labels to tests/llm/fixtures/signal_search_questions.json (1,675 to 1,704, 0 removed) and records the four-arm table, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states status complete (as-delivered blocked, coordinator-repaired with a reason in status-repair.json), names the gate command and its 1-passed-both-runs result, and lists the four gate logs; it carries no baseline_suite/after_suite (an implement-role node), so added failures were derived from gate_before.log and table_run_1.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares three paths (the fixture and two evidence fragments), the diff touches exactly those three, and the granted figures directory is unused, which the done-when permits since it names the fragment rather than a figure.

justifications.durability: tests/llm/test_signal_search_goldens.py:216 require_labelled reddens when a placed label is removed, as negative_control.log shows (EXIT=1), but the explicitly required psc_cref3snu label is in no top 10 so removing it leaves the table passing (negative_control_declared.log EXIT=0).
justifications.evidence: table_run_1.log and table_run_2.log (rev 93b083114) record every arm's nDCG with 1 passed EXIT=0, but the done_when's 0.012-spread clause is unmet (0.7773 vs 0.7920) and is printed at tests/llm/test_signal_search_goldens.py:713 rather than asserted at :717.
justifications.fit: the two fragments keep the module's element-id prefix and the fixture keeps the existing relevant-map shape, with no plan labels or ticket identifiers in source.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/llm/fixtures/signal_search_questions.json gains the 29 lifted candidates and reembed-harness.html records the four-arm table, which is what the goal names.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no function, class or module; it extends the existing owner tests/llm/fixtures/signal_search_questions.json, which a repository search found is read only by tests/llm/test_signal_search_goldens.py.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 9f53972b2..83c08fd4c names only the fixture and the two granted fragments, all inside the declared write paths.
